text: This is Amara. She braids hair in Peckham, and every night her DMs look like this.
Brief Builder turns them into bookings.
A client sends a photo and a few words.
It reads the photo, prices it from Amara's own list, and drafts the reply.
The photo says medium. Amara can tell it's more of a smedium. One tap.
The price moves, the reply rewrites itself, and that fix goes with every draft after it.
So the next person with the same photo gets it right first time.
It picks up how she talks, too. She rewrote one draft last week.
Now every draft says hiya lovely, the way she does. Heart and kiss included.
When the answer is no, it looks for the closest yes. Over budget? Bigger braids, same length, and it still comes in under a hundred and fifty pounds.
Then the classic: does that include the hair? The reply keeps Amara’s fix, and just adds the extra to the total.
We tested it on sixty messages it had never seen. On its own, the model got thirty percent fully right. With her fixes and her rules, seventy-two. Same model. Same messages.
Every call goes through Mubit. Her fixes improve the very next draft, and Mubit keeps them as training data for a small model of her own.
Lou does colour. Jade does nails. Same app, their own prices, their own voice, and each one learns from her own fixes.
[curious] Can you do these? … [warmly] Booked. … Brief Builder.
